subject.title: fix(memory): report indexed vector store in status

question: Should plain `openclaw memory status` report builtin vector-store readiness from persisted `vectorDims` metadata while leaving `--deep` as the live sqlite-vec probe?
rationale: The patch is a narrow bug fix, but it intentionally changes the meaning of the fast status surface from live store loadability to prior successful vector indexing, which is maintainer-owned CLI/API semantics.

options.title: Accept metadata-backed fast status
options.body: Land this PR if maintainers agree that plain status should report prior successful vector indexing from metadata and reserve live sqlite-vec validation for `--deep`.

options.title: Require live-probe semantics
options.body: Ask for revised wording or a separate indexed-vector field if `Vector store: ready` must always mean current-process sqlite-vec loadability.

options.title: Pause for a different contract
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and redirect the PR if maintainers want a different memory-status contract before this behavior changes.

recommendation.title: Accept metadata-backed fast status
recommendation.body: Land this PR if maintainers agree that plain status should report prior successful vector indexing from metadata and reserve live sqlite-vec validation for `--deep`.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent is the live assignee and has recent memory-core SQLite/vector migration history on the affected files.
